messages.text: Oye, did you see that county text about the new spring schedule? I deleted mine by accident.
Sis, my coworker asked if that back bedroom by you is sitting empty. His nephew starts at the warehouse near 249.
Yes. I saved the Houston Health Department link. It says to check the age table before making the pharmacy appointment.
It has the sewing table and Manuel's Astros boxes now. I don't want somebody's mail, keys, and schedule mixed into our house.
Mándamelo. You always keep the official stuff.
Sent. I am asking Dr. Nguyen too when I go Friday, just to make sure Manuel and I pick the right date.
Entiendo. I told him I would only ask once.
Thank you. We already have enough with the 77086 traffic and this roof estimate.
Mana, I put the blood pressure numbers in the green familia group. Did you see them?
Yes, I saw them there. I also saw Elena's note about Sunday, so I answered both at once.
Did you see that clip Tia Lupe put in the cousins chat? Sounds serious.
Send me where it started, not just the screen recording. The date in the corner looks old.
Good. I don't check the blue page unless someone tells me. Too many people writing everything.
Same. I only looked because St. Anne posted the Lenten dinner times and Mrs. Ramirez added photos.
You and your detective work, hermana. I only watched half.
Better than scaring Mama's sisters for nothing. I am looking at the county page before I answer them.
Estas despierta todavía? I forgot what time Elena said Sunday.
Still up. I had the newspaper grid open and my pencil in hand. Sunday is 2:00.
Gracias. You and that pencil at night.
Better than staring at the ceiling. I wrote your blood pressure reminder on tomorrow's list too.
Mom, I found the little brass candle cups in the garage box with the orange tissue paper. Want me to set them aside?
Yes, mija. Put them with Mami's blue frame and Papi's black-and-white one. I don't want the glass scratched.
Got it. The tag on your flower bundle says reorder by September, so I took a picture for you.
Thank you. The orange ones sell out early, and last year I had to drive to three stores.
The clinic tablet is asking those two background questions again before my lab visit. Same boxes as last time?
Si, amor. One question gets the family-origin box, then the next page I use the plain W box. I can fix it when we get there.
Good because I don't want to fight with this tiny screen before coffee.
No pelees con la maquina. Finish the consent page and I will do the rest.
I can stop after work. H-E-B or Costco?
Found that old envelope in the hall closet. The 1995 courthouse pictures are still stuck together.
H-E-B today. Need tomatillos, cilantro, carrots, and the small bowls from the paper aisle if they have them.
Leave them on the kitchen table. Elena wants to scan some before Sunday.
Small bowls again? You feeding us like samples now?
Daniel is going to laugh at my mustache. Houston humidity was not kind to me.
Only so nobody takes the giant servings before the pot even settles.
He already saw worse in the old apartment pictures with both cribs by the window.
That gray Accord is still by the Garzas' driveway. Same one from before?
I put it in the block text. Mrs. Vega said she saw it circling twice before dark.
You want me to step outside or just keep porch light on?
Porch light is enough. If it is there past 10, I will use the city number, no drama.
That roasted poblano rice clip you sent me is dangerous. I saved it before I forgot.
I had three little squares saved this morning already: that rice, raised beds with marigolds, and a courtyard in Oaxaca.
Your phone thinks you are feeding us, planting the yard, and leaving town all before lunch.
Then it showed me the blue house with the old kitchen tiles. That one I kept too.
Did the new girl survive receiving today, or did you finally use that scary clipboard voice?
No scary voice. I sat with Ana for 12 minutes and showed where the second initials go. The old sheet skipped that box.
Of course you found the missing box. You and your little tabs, comadre.
Tabs keep me from saying something ugly. I fixed page 2 and printed three copies before I left.
Did you see that video going around about the tank leak by Red Bluff? Everybody at the shop is forwarding it.
Not sharing it until I see who measured it. If there is a release, the readings and the shift logs should be posted, not guessed.
True. Half my crew is saying shut the whole place down, other half says leave it alone because checks come from there.
Those checks fed our house too. That does not mean families near the fence or guys on night shift should be left with mystery numbers.
Mateo's got that little cough again. If we come Sunday, can you make the warm lemon thing he likes?
Yes, mijo. I have honey and lemons. I will rub a little Vicks on his back after bath if Linda says okay.
Good. Also my neighbor sent those party gummies for the adults. We can leave them here.
Leave them, please. I will put Topo Chico and one bottle of wine for dinner, that is enough.
Mom, for that QA posting, do they really need your old records again?
Yes. I found the folder with my senior-year paper, Lone Star grades, and the ISO cards from work.
That should be enough. You have more plant floor proof than most people with fancy binders.
Those binders came one module at a time, mijo. Night classes, lunch trainings, whatever fit after shift.
Ma, are you still cooking Sunday or should I pick up something after the clinic closes?
I am cooking. Ask Daniel if he is driving in from Katy, and tell him I still have the blue cup here.
He said maybe after nap time. If the little one comes, do you want me to grab the apple juice boxes?
Yes, just one small pack. I washed the sheets in the back room in case they stay late.
Mom, are we still talking about that city council clip Sunday? I want Daniel to hear what you said about not just buying cameras and calling it done.
Yes mija. If they record everything but nobody reviews the hard calls, what is the point?
Exactly. Also I sent you the East End Legal Aid link. No pressure, just thought you might like the local one.
I did a small $25. And Sunday we can talk at the table, not fight in the family chat.
Found that old tin box in the hall closet. It has your dad's maintenance badge and your mom's cafeteria name tag.
Shop called. Truck will be ready tomorrow, but it is more than I guessed.
Okay. I moved the Macy's cart out of checkout and put the lunch place off for Friday.
Leave it on the dining table, please. I want to put those with the Jalisco postcards before Elena comes Sunday.
Those pants can wait, mi amor. The truck has to get me to work.
Also a photo of you and Arturo on that little porch. Looks like Houston before all the freeways got bigger.
Yes. I will use what is in the closet and cook the chicken tonight.
That porch heard more Spanish than the radio. I will sort it after dinner.
Mom, can you send me that old playlist you put on when we make masa? Mateo keeps asking for the loud trumpet one.
I have it saved under Papa's Sunday records. The one with the big voice is probably what he means.
That's the one. He started doing the little grito in the kitchen, scared Ana.
Tell him his bisabuelo would have laughed. I will send it after dinner.
Traffic already ugly on 225. You walking out at your regular time?
Trying. Audit samples went sideways, so I may be there until 6.
I’ll start the rice late then. Also the 4,700 deposit showed, so I paid CenterPoint.
Good. Leave the car note for Saturday after I check the deductions page.
I put the pencils and the little calculator in your tote. You still going by Harrisburg after work?
Si. The 7th graders have fractions again, and I want the examples clean before they copy them.
I figured. Dinner will wait. Just don't skip eating, maestra.
Gracias. I packed a banana. If a child is staying late, I will stay until they finish one page the right way.
Comadre, did you finish the Azuela chapters or are you still fighting with your sticky notes?
Ya casi. I marked the part where the men argue over land, but I want to reread it before tomorrow.
Good. Marta is going to ask about that, I can feel it. Bring your little notebook.
I put it by my purse. If I forget, you can laugh at me at Lupita's.
Tia Lupita says the paper you asked about was from the San Juan de Dios side, not Zapopan.
Good, gracias. I put that with the Guadalajara folder and the plaza map. I want enough days there to sit and look, not rush door to door.
First make sure Manuel's bill and your clinic account are done, hermana.
I know. Blue envelope only gets what is left after March transfers.
Mom, are you still going by Memorial Park before we come over?
Just one loop, mijo. Then I need to do the band exercises before everyone gets here.
Good. Don't try to prove anything before chasing Mateo around.
I learned my lesson after that long court morning. I am behaving.
We may come by after the game. Want us to bring anything from Katy?
Just fruit if you pass H-E-B. I made beans and chicken, and I’m keeping my rice scoop small tonight.
Got it. Mateo will ask for tortillas like always.
He can have his. I’m taking two and then walking around the block with him before dessert.
Are you going early tomorrow or just for the 10:30 at St. Martha's?
10:30. I only said I could help in the hall after if they are short on coffee and trays.
Ok. I can bring foil pans if you want. Also Manuel asked if you still need masa for next weekend.
Yes, one bag is enough. Not doing a huge batch, just enough for the family.
You already left? Coffee is still hot.
Doing the bayou stretch before the sun starts acting crazy. My watch was only at 2,900 when I left.
Don't race the weather, Sonia. I can start the H-E-B list.
Gracias. If I finish the extra block I should be close to 10,000 before errands.
Truck place finally posted the charge. It was ugly, but she runs quiet now.
I saw it. With that added, March is landing close to $6,200 unless Costco behaves.
Costco never behaves. Want me to move my Friday check toward the house draft first?
Yes, house draft first, then the auto note. I already set the card to pull the whole statement on the 18th.
Sis, do you still have that copy of my old clinic bill? I think they are asking for the same paper again.
I have the photo from last August and the paper one in the blue family folder. I can send the photo after dinner.
You keep everything, verdad. I would have thrown it in a drawer.
Drawers cost time later. Send me the new amount before you pay it so I can compare it with the old notice.
Got home late. 225 was a mess by Pasadena again.
I figured. I kept our Sunday window open. Did you write down your numbers this week?
Si, jefa. Teresa still telling you not to make three spreadsheets for one lunch?
She said that on Tuesday and made me laugh for ten minutes.
Mom, did Dad tell you about the kitchen sink leak? Plumber said around $400 if the part is what he thinks.
He told me. I can pay it from the house buffer tonight, then I will put the line back over the next two checks.
Good. I was worried you were going to put it on the card.
No, mijo. The card is only if we get careless. I still have to leave room for the refill pickup and Manuel's appointment charge this week.
Mami, do you need me to stop for cilantro before I come over?
No, I cut enough this morning. If the epazote perked up after watering, I'll put a little in the beans.
Perfect. The store bunches never taste right anyway.
Bring limes instead, and remind me to check the little peppers before everyone sits down.
You already went around the garden?
Almost done. Took Omar instead of Cortland because that black dog was loose by the blue fence again.
Bueno. Come back before the driveway feels like a pan.
I am two blocks away. 9th still has water along the curb, so I crossed early.
My cousin sent another one. Says the mayor signed something last night.
Let me see if the city site has it. Those screenshots travel faster than the truth.
I figured you would check before I opened my mouth at breakfast.
Nothing from the city, and the article name matches one from 2022. Tell him to wait.
You still buried in those charts after work, hermana?
Yes. Tonight is sample-size math, then I have to clean up that little bakery's intake form for Rosa.
No te canses. But if they pay you for fixing messy forms, better than long days at the plant.
That's the idea eventually. Small jobs, fewer long shifts, and still using my brain.
Mom, do you still have that county booklet? I forgot there were judges on this one.
I have it on the counter with sticky notes. I looked at the judge ratings last night and the drainage language too.
Of course you did. I just need the short version before Katy pickup.
Short version: do not skip the back page. The quiet offices matter more than people think.
You still at the plant? I can wait on dinner.
Leaving soon. The old Access tracker froze while I was matching sample IDs to the morning results.
That computer needs retirement before we do.
No kidding. I wrote the missing IDs on the checklist so I can fix the record first thing.
Astros replay is on after the 9 o'clock segment. You watching with me or already doing your quiet routine?
Quiet routine. I looked at the insurance letter once and that is enough for tonight.
Good. Leave the phone by the charger and come sit. No more refreshing.
After ten minutes of stretching. If that letter changes, it can wait until breakfast.
Ma, you answered my work call so calm. I was ready to hang up on that man.
You breathe first, then ask which step he is stuck on. If the paper is confusing, fix the paper.
That sounds like your job voice. Very dangerous, very quiet lol.
Quiet works. I made a three-line note for your front desk folder if you want it.
Traffic on 45 is ugly. I put the chicken to thaw before I left.
I have rice going. Can you grab cilantro if you pass Fiesta?
Yes. Also saw the Astros start at 7:10, so don't let me miss the first inning.
Then hurry. Plates at 6:30 if that freeway behaves.
Could you grab Mateo from daycare Friday if my meeting runs over?
Friday I can only do after 4:45. My desk hours are steady this week unless another customer deviation hits.
That works. I’m moving our bills around too, so I get it.
March is tight but normal: 6,200 listed, 4,700 lands, then insurance and 401k come out before I even touch it.
Mom, if the contractor comes Saturday, should I bring Mateo or is the house going to be torn up?
Bring him after lunch. The man is only measuring the front windows, and Manuel will move the couch before he gets here.
Ok. Also Marisol's cousin still needs a place for two weeks near your side of town, but I figured you would say no.
You know me. Family visits are fine, but I don't want someone settling into the hallway bath and coming in late while we are sleeping.
Mami, you passed by Yale already? I saw someone with your pink cap.
That was me. I needed another small lap because the little wrist number was short.
Please drink water. It is already sticky outside.
I have my bottle. Just trying to hit 8,000 before my first meeting.
Mami, did they ever call you back about that truck window from Mrs. Lujan's place?
Only an email with the report number. She said that is what happened when her shed lock was cut too.
Of course. But they show up fast for some houses and slow for others.
I know. Still, I want the paper trail when the neighbors send photos.
Mami, do you still have my old clinic volunteer badge from senior year? The one from Memorial area?
Maybe in the blue bin with Daniel's Katy move papers and your HISD folders.
If you and Manuel are opening bins, take a picture of the courthouse one too. I need dates for the collage.
I will check after work. Those boxes have followed us through every Houston closet.
Mom, front desk has people asking about the new CDC chart. Some are quoting Facebook again.
Ay no. I printed the CDC page and the city update. I will follow those and what Dr. Nguyen told me.
Good. Pharmacy has appointments open after work if you and Dad want one.
Book us for after 5 if the pharmacist says the timing matches the table.
I can move dinner later if you are doing your Thursday video.
Yes, 6:30. Only the easy sequence tonight, then ice pack while the rice cooks.
I'll start the beans. You keep the living room clear from those foam things.
I found the small Barcelona street book you wanted. It has those narrow lanes marked better than the big shiny one.
Perfect. I need margins for my times and little stops. If it fits in my purse, even better.
Of course you need margins. Your purse is going to have a whole operations manual.
Only after the emergency account gets its piece Friday. No book buying before that.
Lunch tomorrow still good? I finished the book you gave me, by the way.
Yes. I need that chapter talk. Today was too much spreadsheet in my head, so I am doing the Thursday crossword first.
Ay Sonia, the crossword has become your evening supervisor.
It keeps me from rewriting the same grocery list five times.
Ya fuiste por tus pastillas o vas mañana?
Fui el martes. Setenta y dos en la caja now, so no excuses.
Good. And don’t skip your walk because está lloviznando.
I’ll do laps inside H-E-B. Also leaving the pan dulce there, so don’t tempt me Sunday.
Hermana, my stomach has been acting up since lunch. You still make that tea Ma used?
Manzanilla with a little honey, slow sips. If the pain stays sharp, no guessing, you go in tomorrow.
Okay. And Sunday at Chuy's, you want me to save you a margarita?
Half of yours is enough for me. I am bringing my mineral water.
Morning Ma, sending the daycare picture before work. He wore the Astros cap you found.
Ay, so big already. Tell him Abuela saved the train pajamas here.
He keeps asking about your house. Not this weekend though, we have the birthday in Katy.
That is fine. I only need a little notice so I can move my sewing basket out of that room.
Sent you Mateo's school picture in the green group. He insisted on the Astros cap.
I saw it before lunch. Your dad already put three laughing faces.
Also, Katy Little League put the rain delay on the blue page, but I didn't tag anybody.
Send me the screenshot there when you can. I don't want to write under the post.
Mateo has that school heritage sheet due Monday. Can you ask Tio Arturo how to spell the town by Guadalajara?
Si, mijo. It is near Tepatitlan, but I want Arturo to confirm the accent marks before I write it for him.
Thanks. Teacher also wants what language he hears at grandma's house, so I put 'mostly what Nana uses when she's serious.'
Ay Daniel. Put that he hears both here, and the old prayers when I light the candle.
Ma, for Sunday's table, do you want me to write the little cards in English or Spanish?
Both, mija. Your abuelos would fuss if the Jalisco side got left plain.
Ok. Also Daniel asked if the story about you and Tio Arturo sharing one tiny room was real.
Real enough that your grandma's sewing machine sounded like bedtime to us.
Mami, do you still want me to grab paper plates for Sunday or are you skipping extras after the truck drama?
Grab one pack, not the big one. I'm trying to pull this month back from $6,200 toward our normal line.
Got it. At least both checks hit today, right?
Yes. After all the little boxes, mine was $3,060 and your dad's was $3,880.
We doing errands tomorrow or are you making me stop by the community center first?
Community center first, before Costco. Less line in the morning and I want it done before the last-minute crowd.
Fine. I will bring coffee if you bring that folder you keep guarding.
Deal. I still need to reread the county attorney section tonight. The mailers made it sound too easy.
Lunch today or are we both pretending leftovers are exciting?
Leftovers for me, amiga. I packed beans and rice so the truck bill does not follow me around.
Fine, next time. And don't let that office blouse sale tempt you.
I looked, sighed, and closed the tab. My old cardigan still has one more month in it.
Lunch is still on if your Friday binder did not eat you alive.
I can make 12:40. I just need to print the signed pages and tuck the March trend chart behind the SOP copy.
Bring yourself, not the whole binder, comadre.
Deal. The little R script finally made the chart clean enough, so I am closing it now.
Lunch still on for Tuesday, or did the sink eat the lunch money too?
Lunch is fine. The $400 went in my budget app already, and I marked two deposits to fill that bucket back.
You and those buckets. At least they keep you from doing drama math.
Drama math is when I forget the CVS charge, the clinic charge, and the payroll health money all land in the same month.
I found the mole recipe tucked inside that old safety manual. We really did keep everything in those cabinets.
Save it for me. Arturo asked if I was making mole when he comes in from Pasadena.
Then make the lighter version. And don't let him dodge the numbers talk.
I know. He listens more when I ask during our Sunday call first.
Vienes a Pasadena hoy or are you busy with your senoras?
Hoy no puedo, hermano. Tengo las paginas de Espana pendientes and they already moved my turn once.
Otra vez con tarea en sabado. Bueno, dile a Manuel que le guardo los tornillos.
Gracias. Voy despues de comer si terminamos temprano.
Sis, you still have Dad's old lunch pail? I found one photo from when you started at the lab.
Send it. That first check helped keep the lights steady that summer, remember?
Claro. Mom cried when you brought groceries home.
And then I kept adding classes and those company cards whenever the schedule allowed.
Sis, do you still have the photo of Dad in the white shirt? I found another copy in an old envelope.
Bring it when you come. Mine is fading, and I put his picture next to Mami's every year.
Okay. You want the little candy he liked too, or are you doing the bread again?
Maybe both. For Mami I still make the small mole plate, even if Manuel says I cook too much.
Mom, are you still wrapping those with Elena today? Mateo wants to help but he mostly just steals olives.
Yes, after lunch. He can spread the leaves on the table, that is safe.
We'll come after his nap. Are you going to St. Martha's tomorrow too or staying home after all that cooking?
Going in the morning. I promised Rosa I would leave two dozen in the freezer bag for the hall kitchen.
Mom, Mateo asked why his abuela has graph paper in her purse.
Tell him it is for the kids at the center. And for him too if he wants to draw Astros scores in rows.
He said you have to show him the box method Sunday. Also Ana found extra markers for you.
Perfect. I will bring pan dulce after Mass, then we can sit at the kitchen table and make the columns neat.
Mom, can you send that balcony tomato thing again? Luisa wants to try it with Mateo.
Yes. It was between a chile relleno reel and a Madrid street with all the painted doors, so give me a minute to find it.
No rush. You always have the useful squares mixed with pretty ones.
Found it. Right after the Menil post with the flower crown portrait.
Ma, I saw the weather app. Did you go already?
Yes, just the garden blocks. I stayed on Rutland until the last turn because the Waverly corner was still messy.
Good. Please don't wait until after breakfast on days like this.
I know. Back home with coffee, and the little tan dog only barked from the porch today.
Mami, please don't open the clinic portal again tonight. I can look at the lab note with you tomorrow after lunch.
I closed it. Dinner first, then my little prayer list.
Gracias. And no headline videos while you're brushing your hair, okay?
I know. Last time I did that, I was awake past midnight.
I moved the hose like you asked. Sun is already mean out there.
Gracias. I only need ten minutes after H-E-B, mostly to tie the tomato stems and pull the curled leaves.
Your rosemary survived better than my grass, of course.
Because I baby that corner. Save me the kitchen scissors if you see them.
At Costco. The big detergent is $18.99 and the coffee is on sale. Want both?
Yes on coffee. Detergent only if it keeps us under the Saturday line I wrote in the sheet.
You and that sheet. I can skip the ribs then, before you make a face at the receipt.
Get the chicken instead. I already moved the truck payment reminder to the 20th and don't want the cushion smaller.
Did the chile paste behave, or did it punish you for measuring?
It behaved. I used half the manteca and added mushrooms with the zucchini.
Spreadsheet in your head even in the kitchen, Sonia.
Come laugh tomorrow after church. Elena said she might bring rice.
I found my mother's old party list. Pure kitchen noise: violins, horns, everybody singing too loud.
That sounds like our house when Arturo and I were little. My dad would turn it up before anyone finished coffee.
Of course he did. That is why your tamales come with a soundtrack and instructions.
Some things have to stay the same or the table feels wrong.
Are you still doing food before the game tonight or should I eat before I come?
Come hungry. Manuel is cleaning the patio table and I have beans already soaking.
I'll bring the aguas. Tell Dad not to touch the TV settings again, please.
Too late, he already asked where the orange remote went.
Ma, one patient showed me a TikTok saying the clinic is hiding a water notice. She was scared and it had no city link.
Tell her to check the city page or 311 first. People get hurt when rumors travel faster than lab results.
And guess who had to translate the actual notice because nobody gave her one in Spanish.
That is the part that makes me mad. The plants keep running, the city keeps collecting fees, but families still have to beg for plain instructions.
I left the printer paper by your laptop. The practice pages ate half the tray.
Gracias. I need the defect-rate problems on paper, and later I want to compare our insurance numbers for a 3-day schedule.
After Costco? I can look at the spreadsheet if you promise not to make it 12 tabs.
Only 5 tabs this time. Plus one for the kind of cleanup projects I could take from home.
Lunch Friday? I need your spreadsheet brain on these ballot people. Mine gave up after the third smiling mailer.
Friday works. I am making a little chart: who says training, who says review the videos, who says send someone besides only a badge for certain calls.
Good. And no, I am not standing downtown for four hours with my knee. We can still do something useful.
Same here. I already gave a little to the group Elena sent. Now I want to choose better at the local level.
Mom, that patient brought in a printout from a post and asked if we were hiding something. I almost screamed.
Ay no. I always look for the clinic or county page first. A big headline with no source is just noise.
Exactly. I told her to ask the nurse and not her aunt's group chat.
Good. Send me the printout later if you want; I can find where they cut it from.
Mami, I can bring tortillas Sunday. Those patient calls had me tense all day.
Bring tortillas if you want. I am putting Sunday steps in the notebook now, then one page of my book.
You always do the notebook and book combo at night.
It helps me close the day. I also saved you the easy Sudoku from today's paper.
Servicer email came again. It wants both initials on the escrow change.
Forward it to me. I can do mine after I get home, before we heat up dinner.
Also the garage clicker count is still two. I found the old broken one in the drawer.
Good. Keep it that way. Elena has the keypad code when she visits, and that is enough.
For the volunteer badge form, did you choose the same two-part answer again? Mine made me click through three screens.
Yes. The ancestry page gets the answer from my parents' side, then the next page I pick W. Same routine every time.
Of course they make the simple thing into a spreadsheet. Bring that mole recipe Sunday, comadre.
Te la mando tonight. My aunt wrote half the steps in the margins, so I need to copy it clean.
Lunch tomorrow still on, or are you monitoring the block like a night manager again?
Do not start. The alley camera caught someone trying two car doors by the duplex.
Ay. Did your group send it in?
Yes, with the time stamp. I told them to keep it factual because last time the answer was just another number to file.
Voy manana? I can bring soda.
Come by around 1. I got the meat from the carniceria already, just need to warm the caldo slow.
Con tortillas?
Yes, and I put more cabbage and carrots this time so do not complain.
Sis, did you keep the picture of Mom with the yellow flowers from last year?
Yes. It is in the envelope with Dad's card and the little candles.
Good. I found the clay dish from Tia Licha. Bring it when we meet after St. Martha's next Sunday?
I can. I am only staying a few minutes after, to help fold the white cloths.
Mom, the school parent chat is wild. Somebody posted that clip from last night's stop near Navigation and everyone is arguing.
Wait for the full record, mijo. A short clip can miss a lot, but the report and camera should match.
Same group is blaming the port plants for every smell today. Hard to tell what's real.
Smell complaints need numbers, not shouting. And if the numbers are bad, the company and the city should not hide behind paperwork.
Mom, Mateo found the picture of me in the orange tee at the old Sharpstown place. Was that before Elena was walking?
Yes. Manuel had just fixed that noisy window unit, and Elena was still holding the couch to stand.
Send that one for the Sunday slideshow. Mateo keeps asking why everybody stayed in Houston.
Because our people, jobs, schools, and babysitters were all here. That mattered.
Ma, I can bring soup after my shift. My throat feels scratchy from all the talking.
Come by. I have lemon, honey, and the blue jar. I will heat caldo too.
Please hide me from Tia's backyard table if they light up again. My hair smelled awful last time.
We will stay inside with tea. If you start wheezing, I am taking you to the clinic, no debate.
Costco has the little cereal boxes on sale. Need them for tonight or skip?
Get one box only. Daniel said they are just coming after dinner, not leaving him with us.
Good. I will move the fan into the back room anyway. Elena said she might stop by too.
Perfect. Put the night light on the dresser, por favor.
Lunch at Teotihuacan on Airline still good? I swear you know every road from Pasadena to the Heights.
That is what happens when the family never stops needing rides across town.
Bring the recipe card you mentioned. The one your mom wrote half in Spanish while she was sewing uniforms.
I found it with Dad's work keys. Arturo will laugh at the spelling.
Bring your QA folder Tuesday. I can help put the ISO card and the Lone Star printout in the right order.
Gracias. HR always asks for the same stack like they haven't seen me here since the lab bench days.
They know. They just love paperwork more than coffee.
I'll bring the first offer letter too. It still has the hourly rate typed crooked.
I sent you that caldo verde reel. Do not put it in your family thread until you test it, Sonia.
Too late, Elena already asked for it. I saved the garden account too, the one with clay soil tips.
